whole_commentary_handling: Excluded from narration payload; exact originals and decisions preserved in source audits.
sectarian_finding: The supplied edition contains explicit theological/sectarian/polemical commentary, especially in footnotes, including anti-Shia, anti-Sufi and anti-ta’wil statements. These are attributed editorial views, not words of the hadith. Targeted review did not establish a Shia doctrinal insertion in the quoted matn. Several Persian inline glosses expand the Arabic and should be separated as commentary. Absence of a detected insertion is not full translation certification.
review_scope_and_limits: All three DOCX body and footnote XML parts inventoried and searched for theological, sectarian, commentator and explanatory markers. Strong sectarian keyword candidates and selected long/explicit inline gloss candidates examined against adjacent Arabic. Not full character-by-character or semantic verification of every narration; not narrational authenticity assessment or certified release review.
notes: Original source translation concerns remain attached to affected records. Missing language fields are extracted-unit availability/alignment, not necessarily whole-source absence.

retained_translation_qualifications.decision: Preserve supplied translator wording and record its interpretive character separately; not a verbatim Arabic phrase or an exhaustive claim that all translation glosses were removed.
